description: Intent matrix for Oregon Exterior Experts content generation. Split each post's intent string on ' / ' to resolve: primary_intents[primary] + modifiers[modifier]. Modifier fields ending in '_override' replace the corresponding primary field.

Informational.tone: Educational, physics-first. Lead with the problem, not the sell.
Informational.cta_placement: End of post only. Soft CTA — 'Want us to inspect yours?' or 'See what we found on your neighbor's roof.'
Informational.content_depth: Long-form. 1500-2500 words. Include technical evidence, code references, and building science.

Commercial.tone: Evaluative. Present options honestly, let data do the selling. No hype.
Commercial.cta_placement: Mid-article after comparison data + end of post. Direct CTA — 'Get a quote' or 'Schedule an assessment.'
Commercial.content_depth: Medium-form. 1200-1800 words. Side-by-side data, cost breakdowns, ROI framing.

Transactional.tone: Direct, price-forward. No preamble. Get to the numbers fast.
Transactional.cta_placement: Above the fold + end of post. Urgent CTA — 'Book now,' 'Call today,' 'Get your free estimate.'
Transactional.content_depth: Concise. 800-1200 words. Pricing tables, service area scope, seasonal availability.

Commercial Hub.tone_override: Authoritative but evaluative. Position as the definitive resource for making a buying decision.
Commercial Hub.structure_override: Comprehensive overview. Link to all child spokes inline using one_sentence_summary teasers.

Structural Hub.structure_override: Authoritative overview of the structural system. Link to all child spokes inline using one_sentence_summary teasers.

Financial Hub.tone_override: Numbers-driven authority. Lead with cost data, not opinions.
Financial Hub.structure_override: Cost/value overview. Link to all child spokes inline using one_sentence_summary teasers.

Research Hub.tone_override: Skeptical but fair. Present the field test, not the sales pitch.
Research Hub.structure_override: Research-first overview. Link to all child spokes inline using one_sentence_summary teasers.

Safety Hub.tone_override: Safety-first framing. Lead with risk, not fear. Candid but never alarmist.
Safety Hub.structure_override: Checklist-driven overview. Link to all child spokes inline using one_sentence_summary teasers.

Comparison.structure_override: Side-by-side analysis. Use tables or pros/cons format. Name specific products, materials, or methods.

Local.cta_override: Include city name in CTA. Reference city-specific pricing and regulation from geo-reference-matrix.json.
Local.structure_override: City-specific pricing breakdown. Lead with the local cost range, then justify with code and material data.

Fear-Based.tone_override: Candid but never alarmist. Use real insurance cancellation data, claim denial rates, and cost-of-inaction numbers as evidence.

Problem-Aware.structure_override: Symptom-first narrative. Open with what the homeowner sees (stains, cracks, pooling water), then explain the physics behind the symptom.

ROI.tone_override: Investment-framing. Speak to the homeowner as a capital allocator, not a shopper.
ROI.structure_override: ROI calculation → Payback timeline → Comparison to alternatives.

Investment.tone_override: Long-term value framing. Position exterior work as equity protection, not an expense.
Investment.structure_override: Equity impact → Market data → Cost-of-inaction comparison.

Urgent.cta_override: Emergency-weighted CTA. 'Call now,' 'Same-day response available,' include phone number.
Urgent.structure_override: Response time → Cost range → What to do right now (immediate triage steps).

Tactical.structure_override: Step-by-step actionable checklist. Numbered steps, clear pass/fail criteria.

Safety.tone_override: Safety-first but grounded. Use failure data and material specs, not scare tactics.

Low Friction.tone_override: Approachable, non-technical entry point. Assume the reader has zero expertise.
Low Friction.structure_override: Quick-check format. Can the homeowner do this in 5 minutes from the ground?

Financial.tone_override: Numbers-driven. Lead with the price/ROI data, not the product pitch.
Financial.structure_override: Price breakdown → ROI analysis → When it pays for itself.

Decision-Making.structure_override: Decision tree format. When to DIY → When to call a pro → What to expect from a pro.
